result.title: Fault-Guided Cross-Layer Prediction for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
result.comment: 20 pages including appendix; 4 figures and 21 tables. Preprint
result.summary: Feature reconstruction is widely used for unsupervised industrial anomaly detection in the single-class setting, where only normal images from one product category are available for training. We propose a single-class detector that asks what information one block can pass to another. We treat the depth of a frozen vision transformer as a sequence of discrete transitions. A directed predictor learns a block-to-block hidden-state transition pointwise over tokens. Adjacent-layer cosine similarity exposes four sharp fault lines in DINOv2 ViT-L, separating stable depth segments. The deepest blocks retain semantic context but lose local detail; a prediction from deep or shallow sources to sensitive targets therefore exposes the information that cannot be transported. The fault structure fixes the source and target roles, and the same rule transfers to ViT-B and RADIO-B. We use a bounded foreground prior calibrated solely on training images: it attenuates background evidence without also erasing defects outside the estimated foreground. Using one predictor architecture and a common training-only calibration protocol, image AUROC is 99.75 on MVTec-AD, 99.42 on VisA and 94.27 on Real-IAD. On Real-IAD the object-level AUROC is 96.26. At 256x256 pixel resolution, P-AUROC/P-AUPRO are 98.46/95.97 on MVTec-AD, 99.21/96.12 on VisA and 99.26/96.59 on Real-IAD.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向单类无监督工业异常检测，把冻结 ViT 的深度视为一系列离散转移，训练逐 token 的块到块隐状态预测器，并用相邻层余弦相似度划分出「断层」段以固定源/目标层，再配合仅用训练图像校准的前景先验检测异常。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨层隐状态预测与逐层相似度定位「断层」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中深层语义保留而局部细节丢失、以及 latent 相似度受深度与位置影响的问题，但属异常检测应用，迁移仅为可能线索。
